findings.summary: Two mutations survive the suite and BOTH are equivalent under well-formed data, verified and now documented in the code rather than left for the next reviewer to re-derive. (1) Reversing the oldest-first hop replay: fold() uses Math::max and both nextSequence and seal are gated on ownEpoch, so no observable differs -- the comment now says this instead of claiming the ordering is load-bearing. (2) Dropping '&& sealed.sequence() == 0' from neverOpened: firstEntry reads key 0 specifically and seal() writes at keyFor(nextSequence), so a Seal found at slot 0 always carries sequence 0. Recorded so neither is re-hunted in a later round. No action needed.
findings.failure_scenario: None reachable. Stated so that a future reviewer running a mutation pass sees two survivors and does not spend a round rediscovering that they are equivalent, or -- worse -- adds a test that pins an implementation detail no behaviour depends on.
